title: Understanding the Solar System
description: A short introduction to our solar system.
author: FlowFrames

scenes.heading: The Solar System
scenes.narration: Our solar system is made up of the Sun and everything that orbits around it.

scenes.heading: The Sun
scenes.narration: At the center of our solar system is the Sun, a star that provides light and heat.

scenes.heading: Two kinds of planets

left.title: Inner planets
left.text: Small and rocky, close to the Sun.

right.title: Outer planets
right.text: Huge gas and ice giants, far from the Sun.

scenes.narration: The inner planets are small and rocky, while the outer planets are huge gas and ice giants.

scenes.heading: How it formed
steps: A cloud of gas and dust collapses
The Sun forms at the center
Planets form from the leftover material
scenes.narration: A cloud of gas and dust collapsed. The Sun formed at the center, and the planets grew from the leftover material.

scenes.heading: Remember
scenes.text: One star, eight planets, and billions of years of history.
scenes.narration: To remember: one star, eight planets, and billions of years of history.
